prose: Dylan Saccoccio returns, with a brand new book. We dive into the first chapters of Spirit Whirled: The Holy Sailors, on a quest for the origins of feudalism and the church/state control system found in almost all nations. Expect mind blowing language revelations and debunking of ancient history, through the lens of initiation into the stellar-script of the sky.
